verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is a KYC/AML compliance platform, so non-documentary identity verification is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents only screening against sanctions, PEP, watchlist and adverse-media databases. That is an adjacent capability: it checks risk, not who the person is. Nothing in the pack shows verification against SSN, national registries, or credit-header data, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.
